purpose: Create an immutable parent-owned frozen export release only after exact source, artifact, target-medium, proof, rights/privacy and provenance prerequisites are current, without generating document bytes, changing lifecycle state or authorizing publication.

release_granularity.rule: Each distinct frozen byte artifact has its own release_id, format and digest. A release group never substitutes for per-artifact digest identity.

freeze_preconditions: Parent state is structurally valid, exact state_digest matches bytes and project status is FINALIZATION.
expected_parent_state_version and expected_parent_state_digest exactly match the current parent.
release_id is new and does not collide with any append-only export release.
The requested canonical manuscript identity exactly matches the active canonical manuscript and its exact artifact digest.
Artifact evidence source manuscript id/version/digest exactly matches the active canonical manuscript identity.
artifact_digest equals rendered_candidate_digest and both are lowercase sha256.
accessibility_result is PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_RATIONALE according to the selected target-medium profile; UNKNOWN is not a pass.
correction_ledger_state is CLOSED_CURRENT and refers to the exact final rendered digest.
rights_state is CURRENT_AUTHORIZED and privacy_state is CURRENT_ALLOWED.

provenance currentness is NONE or CURRENT_FOR_BOUND_SOURCE_AND_ARTIFACT; if present, its bound_artifact_digest equals the artifact digest and validation_result is PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE only where policy explicitly permits no external projection.
Every parent_admission_ref required by the selected release profile is present and bound to the exact source/artifact identity.
Any configured author-decision requirement is satisfied by an exact current APPROVED decision; no author decision is fabricated merely to freeze an export.
No prior frozen release is modified or silently rebound.

precondition_order: resolve exact active canonical manuscript identity
validate required admission and author-decision references
seal proposed parent successor with state_version+1 and unchanged lifecycle status
freeze_transaction.failure_rule: Any failed precondition returns an error and commits no parent successor, release record or successful receipt.

export_release_projection.rule: The export release is evidence for the separate Lifecycle FINALIZATION->EXPORT_FROZEN gate. Its existence does not itself change project status.

release_receipt.fixed_lifecycle_rule: lifecycle_status_before and lifecycle_status_after are both FINALIZATION for the Export Freeze transaction.

post_freeze_lifecycle_handoff.required_evidence_ref: The newly registered release_id carrying evidence_type EXPORT_FREEZE_READY
post_freeze_lifecycle_handoff.rule: Only after the release parent successor is committed and recorded by Version/Rollback may the parent issue the separate Lifecycle transition request.

version_rollback_handoff.rule: Version/Rollback records the already-committed release successor; it does not create the release or change lifecycle status.

invalidating_conditions: frozen artifact bytes or digest change
required provenance becomes stale, corrected, withdrawn or validation-failed
invalidation_and_refreeze.when_project_status_is_EXPORT_FROZEN: First route a parent Lifecycle request EXPORT_FROZEN->FINALIZATION using EXPORT_FREEZE_INVALIDATED evidence. Preserve the prior release unchanged. Generate/revalidate externally as needed, then create a new release_id and execute a fresh freeze transaction.

explicit_non_goals: No replacement of the qualified canonical-state model, Lifecycle engine or Version/Rollback runtime
qualification_objective: Prove exact parent/source/artifact/profile compare-and-swap, strict proof/currentness gates, one-format-per-release identity, additive v1-compatible EXPORT_RELEASE creation, immutable/idempotent release history, zero lifecycle/publication/document authority, deterministic Version/Rollback handoff, and fail-closed invalid/stale evidence handling with adversarial fixtures.
qualification_effect: NONE until an executable Export Freeze subject passes hosted and registered A-01 exact-SHA qualification.
